info.name: Taxi API (Rehla)
info.description: Rider / Driver / Admin API. Run order: Send OTP → Verify OTP (token auto-saved) → Register → use role folders. Admin: Login saves admin_token.

item.name: Auth

request.description: Throttled (otp_send). The OTP is written to storage/logs/laravel.log (Log::info) — grab it from there.
Run with the driver token (swap Authorization to {{driver_token}}). is_driver=true requires car_type_id, license_number, plate_number.

item.description: Public OTP endpoints need no token. Authenticated ones use {{rider_token}} by default; for driver calls change the folder/request token to {{driver_token}}.

request.description: Route is spelled 'withdrawl-requests' in routes/api/admin.php — kept as-is so the request works.
UpdateAdminRequest currently requires name, email, password (+confirmation) and its email rule has no ignore-self, so re-sending the same email fails validation.
